title: Joyful Croatian Grain Risotto
description: A buttery, fluffy risotto with mixed grains and fresh scallop, finished al dente and energizing for lunch.
instructions: In a saucepan heat olive oil over medium, add shallot and cook until translucent.
Stir in garlic and sauté for 30 seconds.
Add mixed grains, stir to coat, and toast for 2 minutes.
Deglaze with white wine, stirring until absorbed.
Begin adding warm broth one ladle at a time, stirring continuously until each addition is absorbed.
When grains are al dente and creamy (about 20 minutes), stir in butter, lemon zest, lemon juice, and spinach, letting spinach wilt.
Fold in grated parmesan and season with salt and pepper.
Remove from heat, add the scallop and let it steam in residual heat for 2 minutes.
Serve immediately in a scallop-shell vessel, garnishing with fresh parsley if desired.
